counting_basis: Applicable selector, account context, direction, period and statistic combinations. Account-specific instances are not counted as additional definitions.
resolution: Resolve each definition selector in selectors, period in periods by id, statistic in statistics, and context in contexts. Formula, unit and value_type are defined by the statistic; requirements by the selector; interpretation by the context. All definitions use calculation_version.

periods.label: Current calendar month through the last complete day

amount.label: Total amount
amount.formula: Sum of positive posted amounts in the selected direction. Inflows and outflows are separate; this is not net revenue.

count.label: Transaction count
count.formula: Count of distinct current posted source transactions matching the selection.

amount_share.label: Share of directional amount
amount_share.formula: Selected amount divided by all posted amount in the same account context, currency, direction and period. Unavailable when the denominator is zero.

mean.label: Mean transaction amount
mean.formula: Total selected amount divided by selected transaction count, rounded half-up to six major-unit decimal places; unavailable for an empty selection.

median.label: Median transaction amount
median.formula: Middle selected amount, or the arithmetic mean of the two middle amounts rounded half-up to six major-unit decimal places. Unavailable for an empty selection.

p90.label: 90th percentile transaction amount
p90.formula: Nearest-rank 90th percentile of selected amounts. At least ten transactions are required.

maximum.label: Largest transaction amount
maximum.formula: Largest selected posted amount. Unavailable for an empty selection.

stddev.label: Transaction amount standard deviation
stddev.formula: Population standard deviation of selected amounts. At least three transactions are required; result is truncated to six major-unit decimal places.

active_days.label: Days with activity
active_days.formula: Distinct UTC posting dates containing at least one selected transaction.

days_since_last.label: Days since last activity
days_since_last.formula: Calendar days from the most recent selected posting date to the last complete day in the period; unavailable when no transaction was observed.

bank_cashflow.interpretation: Observed depository account cash movements. Gross receipts are not automatically operating revenue; internal transfers and financing remain separately classified. Account ownership alone does not establish business use.

card_activity.interpretation: Issuer credit-card activity. Purchases describe noncash liability creation; payments describe settlement. Never add these totals to bank cash outflows.
